author: Palocos
body:
Check out the codex on playorna.com to see if anything interests you. 

For me, the t10 raid has some pet gear and a view distance head piece. T8 raid also (only)has pet class gear.

Both the normal dragon t10 bosses have cool gear with a shout out for two handed farming weapons for each class on one of them.

Also, t6 boss Vritra has a kickass charm (status protection, petrify/stun/paralysis immunity, what more could you want, suck it yggdrasil and final horseman!)
